item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Portrait Photo Into Story Frame

turns.text: Can you make this fit a 9:16 Instagram story? Keep all my hair and shoulders—use a blurred copy of the photo behind it if needed. No text.

item.tests: Tests creating a vertical story from a square portrait without clipping the person or distorting the photo.

answer_sheet.Framing: Keep all the hair and shoulders visible in the original photo.
answer_sheet.Filling extra space: A blurred copy of the same photo behind the intact portrait is fine.
answer_sheet.Text and retouching: No text or retouching; preserve my appearance.

must_haves: The delivered image has a 9:16 vertical frame.
The sharp foreground portrait shows the same woman, curly hair and sweater as the attachment.
No hair or shoulder area visible in the source is lost.
The portrait is not stretched or squeezed.
Any added background space uses a blurred version of the source photo, with no text.

turns.text: can you make a pic from this pic

dialog.agent: Sure! What would you like me to turn it into—for example, a professional headshot, cartoon portrait, watercolor painting, or a photo with a new background?
dialog.why: It asks the user to choose what to turn the image into and waits for their preference.
dialog.user: make it fit an instagram story, keep all my hair and shoulders and no text

turns.agent:
I couldn’t create it because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

For a manual edit, set the canvas to **9:16 (1080 × 1920)** and choose **Fit**, not Fill, to keep all your hair and shoulders visible. Fill the extra space with a blurred copy of the photo, with no text.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Reframe this exact photograph into a vertical 9:16 Instagram Story by extending the canvas, not cropping the subject. Preserve the woman's identity, facial features, expression, curly dark hair, gray knit sweater and natural photographic appearance. Keep ALL of her hair and BOTH shoulders fully visible with comfortable margins; do not clip hair or shoulders. Keep the original portrait centered and extend the surrounding green park background naturally above and below and as needed at the sides, with consistent trees, grass, soft daylight and perspective. Naturally complete shoulder edges if necessary. No text, lettering, logos, watermarks, frames or graphics.
